caption: Howard v. Peoplease Holdings, LLC
citation_line: Howard v. Peoplease Holdings, LLC, No. 2:24-cv-09476, ECF No. 34 (D.N.J. Oct. 27, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Allowed an employment plaintiff to add the corporate entity identified through discovery and new commission allegations, but required alter-ego allegations to be pleaded as a theory of liability rather than a standalone count and rejected unnecessary fictitious defendants.
qualification_rationale: Practical Rule 15 guidance for cases involving uncertain corporate employers, veil-piercing theories, and information disclosed only after suit.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive amendment order; no substantive appellate review identified.
